topic.title: Calculating Mobile Cooling Needs at Target PL1

ul.li:
Thermal solutions should be initially designed to the Target PL1 definition and Pre-Si power map analysis:
Target PL1 definition is a steady state / sustained cooling assumption.
Tsys is based on Intel system configuration and airflow. Customers should adjust Tsys based on their design.
